## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

The *Mogharājamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 19), rendered in English as the "Exposition of the Questions of the Student Mogharāja", is a canonical commentary forming part of the *Cūḷaniddesa* in the Khuddaka Nikāya. In the available secondary literature dossier, the work is not subject to substantive independent analysis, appearing solely in bibliographies and footnote references pointing to online tipitaka editions [Ponampon 2018; Ponampon 2019].

 Cross-references and shared verses are also noted with Dhammapada traditions (Dhp 170, Patna Dharmapada, Gāndhārī Dharmapada, and Udānavarga), canonical discourses (DN 14, SN 12.37, SN 22.33, SN 35.246, Iti 38), and later works including the *Kathāvatthu* and *Milindapañha*.
